answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through optical astrometry attestation. Each node tracks the parallax arc of an orbital body, such as a receding comet, using a calibrated telescope array. Attackers must deploy discrete physical optics across verifiable geographic baselines per identity. However, optical occlusions from a stray sparrow or beam wander induced by a passing zephyr degrade angular accuracy, causing false rejections.
